notes.title: Update 0.1.140
notes.notes:
[h1][b]EARLY ACCESS UPDATE 0.1.140[/b][/h1]
- New 2 Mode(Survival and Story)
- New Map adding for Survival
- Performance improvements.
[h2]Story Mode[/h2]
The story and mission are also survival themed. The map is in a Forest atmosphere.It has a high loot setup.
[h2]Survival Mode[/h2]
It is a tough and wild jungle theme.You don't miss a mission, you just try to survive. It has a low loot rate.
